end.summary:
Practised reading position-time and velocity-time graphs.
Identified that position-time slope gives velocity and interpreted flat, rising, and falling lines as motion stories.
Calculated areas under a velocity-time graph: 24 m + 72 m = 96 m.
Read velocity-time slope as acceleration; the slope method was revisited, but teach-back was not passed.
A position-time flat-line interpretation was mixed with acceleration and was not clearly corrected later.
end.parentNote: Asha practised using slope on position-time and velocity-time graphs and using area under a velocity-time graph. Ira explained motion stories clearly and correctly calculated the two graph areas, while repeated slope questions helped them state that v-t slope represents acceleration. There was a mix-up between a flat position-time graph and zero acceleration; this was not clearly corrected by the end. At home, ask Ira to label each graph first—x-t or v-t—then write what its slope and area mean before calculating.
